title: Testing with Spring Boot: Key Patterns

scenes.line1: How do you test Spring Boot apps?
scenes.say: Testing is a must for Spring Boot. But what makes your tests reliable and fast enough for real projects?

scenes.label: Context
scenes.sub: Loads the full app context for integration tests.
scenes.say: Spring Boot Test loads your whole application. It's great for integration tests but can be slow.
Slices like Web MVC Test and Data JPA Test load only what's needed. That means faster, focused tests for controllers or repositories.
Mock MVC lets you simulate HTTP requests without starting a server. It keeps your tests quick and isolated.

scenes.label: Real DB
scenes.sub: Runs real databases for integration tests.
scenes.say: Testcontainers spins up real databases, so your integration tests are much closer to production.

scenes.question: When should you use test slices?
scenes.right: Use slices for unit or focused tests, full context for integration.
scenes.say: Don't use slices for full integration tests. They're best for fast, focused checks on one layer.
